genuinely_new_procedural_gap_proposals.title: Gift of Strength Repeat does not impose Powerstorm repayment
genuinely_new_procedural_gap_proposals.candidate_question: A Spirit with no Energy remaining receives Gift of Strength and has already used an eligible cost-1 Power Card. May it use that card's Repeat without paying its cost again, or does Gift require the same repayment as Powerstorm?
minimum_required_facts: Gift of Strength imposes a card-cost eligibility limit but no additional Energy payment; the eligible Repeat is free. Powerstorm expressly requires repayment.

primary_source_refs.locator: CORE p19 Repeat: no universal repayment instruction

genuinely_new_procedural_gap_proposals.why_not_already_asked: Q40 asks deferred selection, Slow use, cards vs Innates and printed Elements. Q154 asks only Powerstorm repayment. Neither asks the free Gift of Strength case or distinguishes an eligibility ceiling from a payment cost.
genuinely_new_procedural_gap_proposals.novelty_status: source-only proposal; coordinator must adjudicate before adding; no reader information used

The substitution is free while Healthy; while Blighted pay 1 Energy per destroyed disk added.
